nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: LangGraph screening assistant: guards input, lets the model call in-process funnel tools (status, criteria, papers, columns, exports, web/PubMed/research questions, notes) under a server-checked project id, then guards the reply. Paid steps only become PendingActions the owner confirms.

nodes.name: answers.py
nodes.summary: Turns a stored research run result into CSV rows (one per finding), a Word report with numbered references, and bar-chart data restricted to numbers the findings actually state.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM schema for users, projects, documents, conversations, research runs, references, papers, screening decisions, extraction columns/values, notes, label samples and pending actions, plus a session factory that creates tables and applies ADDED_COLUMNS on Postgres.

nodes.name: outputs.py
nodes.summary: Writes a header+rows table as CSV or Excel, neutralising cells that a spreadsheet would execute as formulas by prefixing an apostrophe.

nodes.name: rails.py
nodes.summary: Input and output guardrails: one structured yes/no call to the guard model checks user messages and answers, failing open on errors or timeouts.

nodes.name: test_agent.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the screening agent loop with a scripted fake model: tool dispatch, project isolation, step limits, pending actions, history, web and PubMed tools.

nodes.name: test_answers.py
nodes.summary: Tests answer exports (CSV, Word), chart value filtering, number parsing, formula neutralisation and owner-only access to latest answers.

nodes.name: test_api_extraction.py
nodes.summary: API tests for data extraction columns: creation, confirmed fills over included papers, full-text rereads, billing safeguards, retries and project isolation; exports helpers reused by other tests.

nodes.name: test_api_references.py
nodes.summary: API tests for reference import and deduplication: cross-file dedup, merges, splits, possible duplicates, preprint supersession and project scoping.

nodes.name: test_api_screening.py
nodes.summary: API tests for screening criteria drafting, test runs, confirmed screen-all actions, human overrides, blind labelling and rescreening, using a FakeLLM; provides shared fixtures for other tests.

nodes.name: test_carry.py
nodes.summary: Tests that a paper's screening work (decisions, blind labels, extracted values, PDF link) survives regrouping and duplicate merges.

nodes.name: test_db.py
nodes.summary: Tests document defaults, per-project unique SHA, JSON roundtrip of research results and isolated SQLite session factories.

nodes.name: test_filters.py
nodes.summary: Tests the assistant's paper filtering and counting tools by year, database, decision and extracted value, including superseded papers and error messages.

nodes.name: test_fulltext.py
nodes.summary: Tests open-access full-text discovery (Europe PMC, Unpaywall), safe PDF download (private hosts, size cap, deadline) and matching uploads to papers.

nodes.name: test_memory.py
nodes.summary: Tests the assistant's project briefing and project notes: proposal vs save, forgetting, ownership, bounds and briefing robustness.

nodes.name: test_outputs.py
nodes.summary: Tests CSV/XLSX export formula neutralisation and the project-scoped tab export offered by the agent.

nodes.name: test_rails.py
nodes.summary: Tests input/output guardrails: quoting, fail-open behaviour, blocked research questions and assistant messages, and exclusion of blocked runs from history.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory wiring auth, projects, document upload, research runs, conversations, the screening assistant, reference import, screening, extraction and exports into one API that also serves the static web UI.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Password hashing with stdlib scrypt plus HS256 JWT access-token creation and decoding for the API.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Single pydantic-settings Settings class reading .env: OpenAI models, Qdrant Cloud, web/PubMed search keys, retrieval toggles, database URL and JWT settings.

nodes.name: jobs.py
nodes.summary: Background job layer for the API: crash-isolated Docling ingestion in a child process, research runs, paper resolution, confirmed screening/extraction/full-text-fetch actions, and restart recovery.

nodes.name: pubmed.py
nodes.summary: PubMed E-utilities client turning a question into a keyword query, fetching the newest matching abstracts and shaping them as cited research evidence.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest fixtures for API tests: fake settings, a fake ingest runner, a fake OpenAI client, an inline executor, an app/TestClient factory and user signup helper.

nodes.name: test_api_auth.py
nodes.summary: API tests for health, registration, login, token validation and the JWT secret length guard.

nodes.name: test_api_concurrency.py
nodes.summary: API test proving uploads queue on the ingest executor without blocking other requests.

nodes.name: test_api_conversations.py
nodes.summary: API tests for conversations: CRUD, follow-up rewriting and history, ownership scoping, opt-in web search, web-only chats and UI serving.

nodes.name: test_api_documents.py
nodes.summary: API tests for document upload: indexing to ready, dedup, per-project documents, redacted failures, restart recovery, input validation and privacy.

nodes.name: test_api_research.py
nodes.summary: API tests for research runs: ready-document requirement, project-scoped search, hybrid search, PubMed runs and the paper resolver routing and refusals.

nodes.name: test_auth.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for scrypt password hashing and JWT token roundtrip and rejection.

nodes.name: test_jobs.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for jobs: ingest runner crash/timeout/shutdown handling, interrupted-work recovery, document claiming and error redaction.

nodes.name: test_pubmed.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the PubMed client using a mocked HTTP transport: evidence shaping, failures, keyword queries and API key handling.

nodes.name: test_web.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for Tavily and Firecrawl web search shaping, failure fallbacks and searcher selection.

nodes.name: web.py
nodes.summary: Web search via Firecrawl (preferred) or Tavily, shaping results as project-scoped untrusted web evidence and selecting the configured searcher.

nodes.name: dedup.py
nodes.summary: Groups reference records from several exports into papers via union-find on DOI, PMID/PMCID, then normalised title + first author + year, refusing merges across different DOIs/PMIDs or preprint-vs-article; lists near-identical titles as possible duplicates.

nodes.name: evaluate_dedup.py
nodes.summary: Free offline evaluation of the dedup step on bibliography/ exports: uses shared PMIDs as ground truth and a blind run with identifiers stripped to measure false merges and missed pairs, writing results to data/evals.

nodes.name: evaluate_screening.py
nodes.summary: CLI that exports a project's blind-labelled papers plus criteria as a screening gold set and re-screens them with the current model, reporting recall on includes, stratum-weighted recall, precision and review-pile share.

nodes.name: extraction.py
nodes.summary: Data-extraction columns for systematic reviews: validates column definitions and asks the model for one value per paper with a verbatim quote from full-text passages or the abstract, returning 'not stated' when the quote cannot be verified.

nodes.name: fulltext.py
nodes.summary: Finds legally free PDFs for papers via Europe PMC then Unpaywall, downloads them with SSRF-safe public-host checks on every redirect plus size/time caps, and matches uploaded PDFs to papers by DOI or title on the first page.

nodes.name: funnel.py
nodes.summary: Database service layer for the systematic-review funnel: reference imports, dedup regrouping into papers, split/merge, criteria versions, AI screening runs and human decisions, pending actions, full-text linking, extraction columns, filtered listing/counting/export and stratified label samples, all scoped by server-checked project id.

nodes.name: references.py
nodes.summary: Parses reference exports (PubMed/MEDLINE .nbib, BibTeX/Europe PMC, RIS, Scopus/Web of Science CSV/TSV, Excel) into normalised Pydantic Record objects, sniffing the format from content and reporting unreadable records instead of dropping them.

nodes.name: screening.py
nodes.summary: Title/abstract screening logic: Pydantic criteria/verdict schemas, free metadata checks (year, language, publication type), one quoted AI verdict call per paper with quote verification, extract-field filters, the include/exclude/review decision rule, criteria drafting and cost estimates; fail-safe so unverifiable answers go to review.

nodes.name: test_dedup.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for dedup grouping: transitive DOI/PMID merges, title+author+year matching rules, DOI/PMID conflicts blocking merges, preprint separation, possible-duplicate listing and order-independent canonical record choice.

nodes.name: test_evaluate_screening.py
nodes.summary: Tests for evaluate_screening: metric computation (recall on includes, precision, review pile) and the gold-set export of blind labels, newest rows and superseded preprints, including CLI refusal of empty gold sets.

nodes.name: test_extraction.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for extraction value validation: category options, required quotes, number normalisation, whole-word text matching, full-text passages as quoted data, column limits and failed calls.

nodes.name: test_label_sample.py
nodes.summary: API-level tests for the stratified blind-label sample: stratification by AI pile, blind shuffled listing, top-ups, stratum weights in the export and weighted recall, and merge/staleness handling.

nodes.name: test_references.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for MEDLINE and BibTeX parsing: continuation lines, DOI/PMCID extraction, nested/escaped braces, malformed entries reported, format sniffing, DOI/title normalisation and surname extraction.

nodes.name: test_references_tabular.py
nodes.summary: Tests for tabular and RIS reference imports: Scopus/Web of Science CSV and Excel exports, delimiter and encoding detection, malformed/huge input reporting, RIS tag variants and DOI dedup against PubMed records.

nodes.name: test_screening.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for screening: metadata criteria, AI-only criteria routing, quote verification, fail-safe unclear verdicts, decision rules, criteria drafting/validation, test sampling, estimates and extract-field filters; defines the shared FakeParse model stub.

nodes.name: ask.py
nodes.summary: Retrieval and answer step: project-filtered Qdrant search (dense or hybrid bm25+RRF, optional cross-encoder/Jina reranking), LLM answer with structured claims citing evidence ids, and citation checking that strips invented ids. Also a CLI printing filename + page sources.

nodes.name: chunking.py
nodes.summary: Smart chunking: classifies a parsed PDF as article/report/generic, regroups Docling HybridChunker pieces by section within token budgets, labels chunks with paper and section, and adds per-chunk LLM search context via an injected parser.

nodes.name: evaluate.py
nodes.summary: Offline evaluation harness measuring retrieval recall@k and MRR plus verifier false-claim catch rate and true-claim rejection against eval/gold.json, optionally routing through the paper resolver; results saved to data/evals/.

nodes.name: ingest.py
nodes.summary: PDF ingestion pipeline: Docling parse, smart chunking, OpenAI embeddings and bm25 sparse vectors, idempotent Qdrant upsert with uuid5 point ids and hash-skip; also collection migration, re-chunking reindex, and Postgres chunk-count sync CLIs.

nodes.name: papers.py
nodes.summary: Paper resolver: builds per-paper cards from front-matter chunks, asks the LLM which project papers a question names (requiring agreeing replies), and scopes or splits searches to those papers, declining papers the project lacks.

nodes.name: research.py
nodes.summary: Verified research loop: plans sub-questions, gathers evidence, synthesizes cited answers, verifies each claim with a guard model failing closed, retries within a budget, and saves audit records; also rewrites chat follow-ups into standalone questions.

nodes.name: sections.py
nodes.summary: Section outline builder: one LLM call proposes heading levels and parents, then deterministic repair (section numbering, validity checks) yields a consistent heading tree so every chunk carries its full path and canonical section.

nodes.name: test_ask.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for ask.py covering project isolation of search, invented-citation removal, rendering, reranking order, Jina score mapping, sha filtering, and hybrid search behaviour with a fake OpenAI client.

nodes.name: test_chunking.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for smart chunking: document classification heuristics and LLM tie-breaks, front/back matter merging, tiny-piece merging, labels, titles, contextualization quoting, and outline integration.

nodes.name: test_evaluate.py
nodes.summary: Tests for evaluate.py metrics (relevance matching, recall/MRR, verifier catch rate), gold-file shape, a live baseline check, and resolver-routed search.

nodes.name: test_ingest.py
nodes.summary: Tests for ingestion: deterministic point ids, re-ingest idempotency, partial-upsert repair, cross-project isolation, sparse vectors, migration, reindex/sync-counts, and crash-isolated preparation; includes live Qdrant tests.

nodes.name: test_papers.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the paper resolver: named-paper routing, missing-paper refusals backed by card words, comparison splitting, two-agreeing-reply rule, fail-open behaviour, card building, and scoped search.

nodes.name: test_research.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the research loop: planner caps, evidence dedupe, fail-closed verification, retries on unsupported or invented claims, budget exhaustion, audit records, follow-up rewriting, and a live verifier check.

nodes.name: test_sections.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the section outline: heading occurrences, outline paths, numbering beating the model, parent repair, fallbacks without a model, quoted-JSON prompts, and caption handling.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker that makes the end-to-end eval tooling importable as the `evals` package.

nodes.name: compare.py
nodes.summary: Regression gate that diffs a candidate eval snapshot against the baseline, classifying each metric as gate/guardrail/info and exiting PASS=0, FAIL=1 or REVIEW=2 for CI.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Metric registry defining every end-to-end eval metric with its direction, kind (gate/guardrail/info) and tolerance floors, consumed by compare.py and spread.py.

nodes.name: spread.py
nodes.summary: Measures run-to-run noise across repeated eval snapshots (mean, stdev, spread per metric) and writes spread.json plus an optional mean-baseline snapshot.

nodes.name: test_agent_eval.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the screening assistant tool-routing eval: expected/forbidden tool scoring, any-of alternatives, golden routing set validity and metric registration.

nodes.name: test_check_golden.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the golden-set checker's text normalization and its handling of line-break hyphens and multi-part facts.

nodes.name: test_compare.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for compare.py verdicts: tolerance boundaries and how a vanished gate versus guardrail metric is treated.

nodes.name: test_evals.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the end-to-end eval runner: golden validation, deterministic scoring (evidence hits, abstain, isolation, attribution), snapshot aggregation and HTTP retry behaviour.

nodes.name: test_metric_registry.py
nodes.summary: Tests that every produced metric is registered, plus spread/noise computation and compare's noise-widened guardrail tolerances that never widen safety gates.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing build guide for MaxRIM: the five-step build order (ingest, ask, verify, eval, API), current eval baselines and retrieval experiments, stack rules, commands, and hard rules on secrets, project isolation, idempotency and citations.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Full target design for MaxRIM: problem and vision, architecture, Docling-to-Qdrant ingestion, the LangGraph Planner/Researcher/Synthesizer/Verifier loop, data model, API contract, roadmap, evaluation, security and current status.

nodes.name: README_Evindra_AI.md
nodes.summary: Design document for 'Evidra AI', a systematic-review pipeline from reference import, dedup and screening through Docling parsing, section-aware chunking, Qdrant/Postgres evidence stores, hybrid RAG with Text-to-SQL, and export, with per-stage implementation status.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: uv project definition for maxrim (Python 3.12) declaring runtime deps (Docling, FastAPI, LangGraph, OpenAI, Qdrant, SQLAlchemy/psycopg), dev deps (pytest, ruff, deepeval), pytest markers excluding live tests by default, and ruff line length.

nodes.name: 2026-10-15-api.md
nodes.summary: Step 5 implementation plan (6 tasks) for the authenticated FastAPI + Postgres service: SQLAlchemy models, scrypt/JWT auth, projects with ownership, crash-isolated PDF ingestion in a 1-worker process pool, and verified research runs.

nodes.name: 2026-10-16-hybrid-retrieval.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan (6 tasks) adding a stdlib BM25 sparse vector next to dense embeddings, a collection migration (--migrate-to), and Qdrant RRF hybrid search behind the HYBRID_SEARCH setting.

nodes.name: 2026-10-16-smart-chunking.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan (6 tasks) for chunking.py: document-type classification, type-specific chunk regrouping, title/section labels and LLM search context, plus splitting ingest.py into parse/prepare/write stages and adding --reindex-to.

nodes.name: 2026-10-19-screening-funnel.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan (11 tasks) for the systematic-review screening funnel: .bib/.nbib parsing, deduplication, AI title/abstract screening against drafted criteria, open-access full-text fetch, a tool-calling chat agent, screening UI, and extracted columns.

nodes.name: 2026-10-19-section-outline.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan (3 tasks) for sections.py: one validated LLM call per document builds a repaired heading outline and canonical section per chunk, wired into chunking.build_chunks and indexed by ingest.

nodes.name: 2026-10-15-api-design.md
nodes.summary: Step 5 design for the MaxRIM API: FastAPI app factory, Postgres data model, auth, background ingestion jobs and research endpoints wrapping the ingest/ask/verify functions.

nodes.name: 2026-10-15-eval-harness-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for the end-to-end eval harness: 26 golden cases run through the live API, deterministic plus DeepEval-judged scoring, and candidate-vs-baseline snapshot comparison.

nodes.name: 2026-10-15-frontend-chat-web-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for the static web UI, conversation memory with follow-up question rewriting, and opt-in per-run web search via web.py.

nodes.name: 2026-10-16-hybrid-retrieval-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for hybrid keyword+vector retrieval: bm25 sparse vectors at ingest, collection schema and migration, RRF fusion in ask.search behind the HYBRID_SEARCH flag, and the eval plan.

nodes.name: 2026-10-16-smart-chunking-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for smart parsing and chunking: document classification, chunk regrouping, labelling and per-chunk LLM contextual retrieval text, with idempotent re-index and eval gates.

nodes.name: 2026-10-19-screening-funnel-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for the systematic-review screening funnel: reference import, deduplication, criteria builder, LLM screening, full-text retrieval, agent tools and evaluation gates, plus an extraction-columns addendum.

nodes.name: 2026-10-19-section-outline-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for the section outline (chunker v3): one context-model call per document builds the heading tree and assigns a canonical section to each chunk, with fallbacks and done-when criteria.

nodes.name: 2026-10-22-paper-resolver-design.md
nodes.summary: Design for the paper resolver: builds per-paper cards, asks the fast model which project papers a question names, and routes retrieval to those papers or declines missing ones to stop wrong-paper answers.

nodes.name: agent_golden.json
nodes.summary: Tool-routing golden set (v1, 33 cases) for the screening assistant: each chat message lists tools that must be called (expect/expect_any), tools that must not run (forbid), or no_tools, covering counting, listing, export, criteria, screening, PubMed, web, extraction, memory and injection cases.

nodes.name: golden.json
nodes.summary: Golden set v2 (68 cases) for the end-to-end research eval: answerable questions with expected answers, required facts and verbatim PDF quotes across six papers, plus unanswerable, false-premise, scope, isolation, injection and wrong-paper trap cases.

nodes.name: golden_v1.json
nodes.summary: Archived v1 golden set (26 cases) on EA2022 and JPan2023 for the 'main' and 'isolation' projects, covering answerable, unanswerable, false-premise, scope, isolation and injection questions; superseded by golden.json v2.

nodes.name: golden_v2_review.md
nodes.summary: Researcher review sheet for golden set v2: a table of the 42 new and 5 edited cases (question, expected answer, quote/page, OK column) for human sign-off before v2 becomes a baseline; quotes are pre-checked by evals.check_golden.

nodes.name: RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Chronological log of end-to-end eval runs (runs 1-14, golden v2 with 68 cases, run-to-run spread study, LlamaParse comparison, screening-funnel live runs), recording metric deltas, PASS/FAIL/REVIEW verdicts, failure analyses and which run is the current baseline.

nodes.name: baseline.json
nodes.summary: Promoted E2E eval baseline (run12-section-outline, 26 cases) holding app/judge model metadata and aggregate deterministic, quality (DeepEval judge) and ops latency metrics that candidate runs are compared against.

nodes.name: candidate.json
nodes.summary: Latest E2E eval candidate run (run14-guardrails, 26 cases) with the same metadata and metric schema as the baseline, written by evals.run and checked by evals.compare.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything analysis tool config setting the knowledge-graph output language to English; not part of the application.

nodes.name: gold.json
nodes.summary: Gold question set (v3) for evaluate.py: retrieval questions with expected chunk strings plus verifier fact/trap items across six healthcare papers, scoped to the demo project.

nodes.name: agent_run.py
nodes.summary: Tool-routing eval of the screening assistant through the running API: sends one message per golden case in a fresh project and scores which tools each turn called, writing a candidate snapshot.

nodes.name: check_golden.py
nodes.summary: Free local check that every golden case's quote appears verbatim on its stated PDF page and its facts appear in its source PDFs, with whitespace/dash/hyphenation normalization.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end eval of the running MaxRIM API: runs golden questions as research runs, computes deterministic checks and DeepEval judge metrics, and writes baseline/candidate snapshots.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Main vanilla-JS single-page app: auth, projects, PDF upload, conversations, research-run polling and cited answer/source cards, all over the /api/v1 REST API.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML shell of the MaxRIM web UI (auth, sidebar, chat and screening views) that loads styles.css, app.js and screening.js.

nodes.name: screening.js
nodes.summary: Systematic-review screening UI: funnel counts, criteria cards, 20-paper test, paper tables, review queue, blind labelling, charts, exports and the screening assistant chat with confirm cards; reuses app.js globals.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the web UI covering layout, sidebar, chat turns, source cards, screening tables, queue and toasts.

nodes.name: test_api_live.py
nodes.summary: Live (paid) acceptance test running the README section 10 scenario end to end through the API against Postgres, Qdrant and OpenAI.

nodes.name: test_api_projects.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the projects API: creation and listing, name validation, and per-user project privacy.

layers.name: API & Background Jobs
layers.description: FastAPI app factory with JWT/scrypt auth and the crash-isolated ingest job runner that wraps ingestion, research, chat and screening functions.

layers.name: Web UI
layers.description: Vanilla-JS single-page app served at / for projects, PDF upload, chat with cited research runs, and the screening funnel views.

layers.name: Ingestion & Retrieval
layers.description: Docling PDF parsing, smart chunking and section outlines, embedding plus bm25 upsert into Qdrant, project-filtered hybrid search and the paper resolver.

layers.name: Research & Agent
layers.description: Verified planner/researcher/synthesizer/verifier loop, LangGraph screening assistant, LLM guardrails, and PubMed / web evidence sources.

layers.name: Systematic Review Funnel
layers.description: Reference parsing, union-find dedup, LLM title/abstract screening, open-access full-text retrieval, data extraction, the funnel DB service, and CSV/XLSX/Word exports.

layers.name: Data & Configuration
layers.description: SQLAlchemy ORM schema for users, projects, documents and funnel records, the single pydantic-settings Settings class, and project/tool configuration.

layers.name: Evaluation Harness
layers.description: Retrieval/verifier metrics (evaluate.py), dedup and screening evals, the end-to-end API eval with golden sets, baselines, regression gate and noise measurement.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Pytest unit and API tests with mocked OpenAI/Qdrant, covering project isolation, idempotency, screening, agents and eval tooling, plus paid live acceptance tests.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project README and design docs, the agent build guide in CLAUDE.md, and dated superpowers design specs and implementation plans.
